description_en: Modifies a permission rule in a permission group
name: ModifyAccessRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the permission group
parameters.name: access_group_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the permission rule
parameters.name: access_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address or CIDR block.

The value must be a single IP address or a CIDR block.

You must specify either SourceCidrIp or Ipv6SourceCidrIp. You cannot leave both parameters empty, and you cannot specify both parameters at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
IP地址或网段。

格式必须为单一的IP地址或者CIDR网段。

SourceCidrIph与Ipv6SourceCidrIp二选一，不能同时为空，并且两个参数也不能同时提供
parameters.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
The read and write permissions of the authorized object on the file system.

Valid values:

RDWR (default): read and write.
RDONLY: read-only
parameters.help_zh:
授权对象对文件系统的读写权限。

取值：

RDWR（默认值）：读写。
RDONLY：只读
parameters.name: rw_access_type

parameters.help_en:
The authorization of the system user of the authorized object on the file system.

Valid values:

no_squash: allows access to the file system as the root user.
root_squash: maps the root user to the nobody user when the root user accesses the file system.
all_squash: maps all users to the nobody user regardless of the user identity used to access the file system.

The nobody user is a default user in Linux. This user can access only public content on the server and has low privileges and high security
parameters.help_zh:
授权对象的系统用户对文件系统的访问权限。

取值：

no_squash：允许使用root用户访问文件系统。
root_squash：以root用户身份访问时，映射nobody用户。
all_squash：无论以何种用户身份访问，均映射为nobody用户。

nobody用户是Linux系统的默认用户，只能访问服务器上的公共内容，具有低权限，高安全性的特点
parameters.name: user_access_type

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the permission rule.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1 (highest priority)
parameters.help_zh:
权限组规则优先级。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：1（最高优先级）
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The type of the file system.

Valid values:

standard (default): General-purpose NAS.
extreme: Extreme NAS
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统类型。

取值：

standard（默认值）：通用型NAS。
extreme：极速型NAS
parameters.name: file_system_type

parameters.help_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block.

IPv6 addresses and CIDR blocks are supported.

Only Extreme NAS file systems in the China (Hohhot) region support IPv6 CIDR blocks.
Only VPCs are supported.
IPv4 and IPv6 are mutually exclusive. You cannot convert between the two types.
You must specify either SourceCidrIp or Ipv6SourceCidrIp. You cannot leave both parameters empty, and you cannot specify both parameters at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。

支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址。

仅华北5（呼和浩特）地域的极速型NAS支持CIDR地址段。
仅支持VPC专有网络。
IPv4和IPv6互斥，类型不能转换。
SourceCidrIph与Ipv6SourceCidrIp二选一，不能同时为空，并且两个参数也不能同时提供
parameters.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip
